mapping(address => uint) of token balances; mutated by transfer, transferFrom and the constructor.
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) allowance table written by approve, transferFrom and approveAndCall.
Owner address of the Owned contract; written by the Owned constructor and acceptOwnership.

Constructor that initializes symbol, name, decimals, _totalSupply and pre-mints all tokens to a fixed address.
Constant function returning _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)].
Constant function returning balances[tokenOwner].
Transfers tokens from msg.sender to 'to' using safeSub/safeAdd and emits Transfer.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emits Approval (no double-spend check).
Moves tokens from 'from' to 'to' using the caller's allowance via safeSub/safeAdd; emits Transfer.
Constant function returning allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Sets allowance then executes an external call to ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(...).
Payable fallback function that unconditionally reverts, rejecting plain ETH transfers.
SafeMath addition with an overflow require(c >= a).
SafeMath subtraction with an underflow require(b <= a).
SafeMath multiplication with an overflow require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
SafeMath division with a division-by-zero require(b > 0).
onlyOwner function that stages a new owner in newOwner.
Confirms ownership transfer when msg.sender == newOwner, then resets owner/newOwner.
Owned constructor that assigns owner = msg.sender.
Caller-controlled address used as owner, transfer source, spender and permission check.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the debit account when transfer() updates balances.
transfer() writes balances[msg.sender] and balances[to].
approve() writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
approve() stores the granted allowance in the allowed mapping.
transferFrom() uses msg.sender as the spender whose allowance is debited.
transferFrom() updates balances[from] and balances[to].
transferFrom() decreases allowed[from][msg.sender].
approveAndCall() stores allowed[msg.sender][spender] and forwards msg.sender to the callback.
approveAndCall() writes into the allowed mapping before making the external call.
approveAndCall() unconditionally performs the external receiveApproval call.
The attacker-controlled spender contract can re-enter approveAndCall/transferFrom during the callback.
The Owned constructor sets owner = msg.sender.
The Owned constructor writes the owner state variable.
acceptOwnership() requires msg.sender == newOwner.
acceptOwnership() overwrites the owner state variable.
acceptOwnership() resets newOwner to address(0).
The onlyOwner modifier gates transferOwnership() on msg.sender == owner.
transferOwnership() writes the newOwner state variable.
The owner state variable is the authority checked by the onlyOwner modifier on transferOwnership().
transfer() delegates balance subtraction to safeSub().
transfer() delegates balance addition to safeAdd().
transferFrom() delegates subtraction of balance and allowance to safeSub().
transferFrom() delegates credit addition to safeAdd().
safeAdd() executes the raw uint addition a + b.
The addition result c is returned by safeAdd() after the overflow require.
safeSub() executes the raw uint subtraction a - b.
safeMul() executes the raw uint multiplication a * b.
safeDiv() executes the raw uint division a / b.
balanceOf() reads the balances mapping.
allowance() reads the allowed mapping.
totalSupply() reads the _totalSupply state variable.
totalSupply() reads balances[address(0)] when computing the circulating supply.
The constructor initializes symbol.
The constructor initializes name.
The constructor initializes decimals.
The constructor initializes _totalSupply.

The 'tokens' parameter is the amount moved by transfer().

The 'tokens' parameter is the allowance value written by approve().
The 'from' parameter is the debit account of transferFrom().
The 'to' parameter is the credit account of transferFrom().
The 'tokens' parameter is the amount moved by transferFrom().
The 'spender' parameter indexes the allowance written by approveAndCall().
The 'tokens' parameter is the allowance value written by approveAndCall().
The caller-supplied 'spender' address is cast to ApproveAndCallFallBack and called externally.
The arbitrary 'data' parameter is forwarded verbatim into the external receiveApproval call.
The 'tokenOwner' parameter is looked up in balanceOf().
The 'tokenOwner' parameter indexes the allowed mapping in allowance().
The 'spender' parameter indexes the allowed mapping in allowance().
Operand 'a' of safeAdd() flows into the addition.
Operand 'b' of safeAdd() flows into the addition.
Operand 'a' of safeSub() flows into the subtraction.
Operand 'b' of safeSub() flows into the subtraction.
The '_newOwner' parameter is stored into newOwner by transferOwnership().

normalization_plan.reason: The 'to' parameter only exists to feed the transfer() function's balance update; merge it into that core function node.
The 'tokens' parameter is a pure operand of transfer(); merge it into the transfer() core node.
The 'spender' parameter is only an index for the allowance write in approve(); merge into approve().
The 'tokens' parameter is the value written by approve(); merge into approve().
The 'from' parameter is the debit address of transferFrom(); merge into transferFrom().
The 'to' parameter is the credit address of transferFrom(); merge into transferFrom().
The 'tokens' parameter is the amount moved by transferFrom(); merge into transferFrom().
The 'spender' parameter becomes the target of the external receiveApproval call; merge into that unsafe_operation node.
The 'tokens' parameter is the allowance value written before the callback; merge into approveAndCall().
The 'data' parameter is forwarded verbatim to the untrusted callee; merge into the external call unsafe_operation node.
The 'tokenOwner' parameter is only a lookup key for balanceOf(); merge into balanceOf().
The 'tokenOwner' parameter is only a lookup key for allowance(); merge into allowance().
The 'spender' parameter is only a lookup key for allowance(); merge into allowance().
Operand 'a' feeds the raw addition inside SafeMath.safeAdd; merge into the arithmetic unsafe_operation node.
Operand 'b' feeds the raw addition inside SafeMath.safeAdd; merge into the arithmetic unsafe_operation node.
Operand 'a' feeds the raw subtraction inside SafeMath.safeSub; merge into the arithmetic unsafe_operation node.
Operand 'b' feeds the raw subtraction inside SafeMath.safeSub; merge into the arithmetic unsafe_operation node.
